# a plain add: speed with amplifier 0 and a long duration
EFFECT Add speed added=true
ADV Add minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
ADV Add mv:eff/any c
ADV Add mv:eff/speed c
ADV Add mv:eff/speed_amp_0 c
ADV Add mv:eff/speed_duration_min_300 c
# the same effect upgraded in place (onEffectUpdated)
EFFECT Add speed added=true
ADV Add minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away

ADV Add mv:eff/speed c
ADV Add mv:eff/speed_amp_0 c

# strength for 20 ticks, then speed for 100: the pair is complete, then strength expires with the speed duration at 80 or below
EFFECT Pair strength added=true
EFFECT Pair speed added=true
ADV Pair minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
ADV Pair mv:eff/any c
ADV Pair mv:eff/speed c
ADV Pair mv:eff/speed_amp_0 c
ADV Pair mv:eff/strength_and_speed c
